verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents workers run as persistent 'programmatic participants' deployed to LiveKit Cloud or self-hosted infrastructure, processing realtime streams and telephony calls autonomously in the background without human intervention (docs-8, docs-20, docs-30, docs-26, gh-2), and this is verified hands-on as a real pip-installable OSS framework with a working self-hosted backbone (probe-rt-2, probe-rt-3). Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron-trigger mechanisms, independent third-party reports of long-running unattended stability (the one community mention is about observability tooling gaps, not autonomy failure).
